about: The approved next steps (docs/WORKSTREAMS.md), in order, for the agent bridge to turn into tasks when an agent runs out of work. Each becomes one GitHub issue (agent-task) at most once; 'after' lists keys that must be done first. Edit this file to change what comes next; the coordinator never invents work.

items.title: Smart Screen Actions: check the result of scrolling, opening and shortcuts
items.body: Today Izuki checks clicks (Safe Hands) and typing (read back), but not scrolling, opening an app or URL, or keyboard shortcuts. Add a result check for each, the way check_typed works: decide what should have changed, look, and report a snag when it didn't. Extend automation::action_bench with one row per new check, run it (it waits for an idle PC), and the unit tests.

items.title: Smart Screen Actions: re-plan from a fresh look after any failed step
items.body: When a step's result check fails, take a fresh look and re-plan the rest of the task from the new screen, for every step type, not only the snag note. Bounded (no loops), and never repeats a final action (send, pay, delete). Tests for the loop's limits.

items.title: Fast Action Engine: replace the fixed waits the bench shows matter
items.body: Measure with automation::action_bench and uia::look_timing first. Replace fixed sleeps that cost time with a check for the condition they wait on, one at a time, with before/after numbers in the commit. Keep the ones that let slow PCs settle (izuki-patient-not-spammy).

items.title: Skip YouTube ads through the extension instead of walking the page
items.body: With auto-skip on and YouTube in front, autonomous.rs walks up to 160 page controls every 5 s (about 1% of a core). When the extension is connected, find the skip button in the page instead (one DOM query), and fall back to the walk otherwise. Measure the idle CPU before and after.

items.title: Eye lane: one-gesture calibration behind the eye gate
items.body: From docs/WORKSTREAMS.md §3: after the gate and the iris tracker, a one-gesture calibration, off by default, with the owner's real-camera test before it's called done.

items.title: Eye lane: look-to-scroll as the first eye-only feature
items.body: From docs/WORKSTREAMS.md §3. Behind the same gate; an accessibility summary in Settings.
